scope: Retrospective diagnostic validation on previously uninspected cases 2 and 11; not independent-site or prospective warning validation
units_basis: Paper table 3 states shaft-Hz multiples; physical coefficient interpretation remains unverified
decision: OR across three feature exceedances; all features must be available or abstain
calibration: Each placement publisher train normal records; post-replacement retrospective calibration
invalid: Exclude label -1 or invalid RPM/raw/sampling rate; unavailable spectrum or reference causes abstention
grouping: Per case and placement only; no pooled independent-bearing claim; asset independence not established
promotion: Never automatic; report every miss, false positive and abstention; do not retune
